The Mission Support Specialist (Workforce Management) serves as a liaison between Mission Readiness Operations and various support offices to carry out projects, perform studies, and address technical issues or problems related to the workforce.

Duties and responsibilities include: Assisting managers and supervisors with administrative coordination related to disciplinary and adverse actions, grievances, and changes to working conditions; serving as a liaison with Human Resources and Labor-Employee Relations to support resolution of complex workforce issues; and assisting with implementation of policies related to workforce and position management.

Maintaining workforce reports and updating information for agency manning documents; coordinating with supervisors and staff to ensure timely completion of actions and receipt of required documentation; and submitting and monitoring personnel actions.

Serving as a liaison with support offices, including Labor-Employee Relations, EEO, workers' compensation staff, and counsel, on matters with workforce implications; and preparing reports using internal data sources and agency automated systems to support managerial information needs.

Performing general mission support activities, including coordinating travel and training, organizing logistical elements, analyzing non-overtime budget information, supporting procurement and acquisition actions, and serving as a point of contact for headquarters and/or sector office staff.
FOR: GS-09 Experience: You qualify for the GS-09 grade level if you possess one year of specialized experience equivalent to at least the next lower grade level, performing duties such as: Supporting administrative projects related to workforce management, including project planning, execution, tracking, evaluation, and process improvement.

Researching, compiling, and analyzing data from multiple sources to support decision-making, identify trends, and provide recommendations to improve workforce operations.

Supporting workforce management functions, including staffing, personnel actions, time and attendance, benefits coordination, workforce documentation, or position management activities.

Maintaining and reviewing official workforce-related documentation to ensure accuracy, completeness, timeliness, and compliance with applicable policies and procedures.

Coordinating with supervisors, managers, Human Resources, and other support offices to monitor personnel actions, resolve administrative issues, and support workforce-related projects.

OR Education Substitution: Successful completion of a master's degree, two full years of graduate education leading to such a degree, or a J.D. or LL.B may substitute for the experience required at this level. This education must demonstrate the knowledge, skills, and abilities necessary to do the work.

Check with your school to determine how many credit hours comprise a year of graduate education. If that information is not available, use 36 semester or 54 quarter hours.

FOR: GS-11 Experience GS-11: You qualify for the GS-11 grade level if you possess one year of specialized experience equivalent to at least the next lower grade level, performing duties such as: Leading or coordinating multiple administrative projects related to workforce management, with accountability for project outcomes and ensuring all deliverables meet established standards.

Identifying, analyzing, and resolving a wide range of multifaceted problems relevant to workforce management and workers' compensation, utilizing advanced analytical methods. Conducting advanced data analysis from diverse sources to identify trends, patterns, and develop actionable recommendations for process improvement and compliance.

Preparing and presenting comprehensive reports, briefings, and correspondence for senior management or external stakeholders, ensuring clarity, accuracy, and relevance.

OR Education Substitution: A Ph.D. or an equivalent doctoral degree, three full years of progressively higher-level graduate education leading to such a degree or an LL.M. degree from an accredited college or university may substitute for experience required at this level.

This education must demonstrate the knowledge, skills, and abilities necessary to do the work. Check with your school to determine how many credit hours comprise three years of graduate study. If that information is not available, use 54 semester or 81 quarter hours.

NOTE: Your resume must explicitly indicate how you meet this requirement, otherwise you will be found ineligible. Please see the "Required Documents" section below for additional resume requirements.

Combining Education and Experience: Combinations of successfully completed post-high school education and experience may be used to meet total qualification requirements for the grade levels, and may be computed by first determining your total qualifying experience as a percentage of the experience required for the grade level; then determining the your education as a percentage of the education required for the grade level; and then adding the two percentages.

The total percentages must equal at least 100 percent to qualify for that grade level. Only graduate education in excess of the amount required for the next lower grade level may be used to qualify applicants for positions at grades GS-9 and GS-11. More information on this qualification standard is located here.

Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional; philanthropic; religious; spiritual; community, student, social).

Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience.

You must: Meet all qualification requirements, including education if applicable to this position, subject to verification at any stage of the application process; and Meet all applicable Time in Grade requirements (current federal employees must have served 52 weeks at the next lower grade or equivalent grade band in the federal service) by 08/11/2026.

Advanced Utility Systems, a division of Harris; is seeking a Vice President of Customer Support who leads the customer support organization with full accountability for strategic direction, operational execution, service quality, customer retention, and cost-to-serve performance.
This executive owns the complete support lifecycle, from first-contact ticket resolution and after-hours incident response through quality assurance, root cause analysis, workforce planning, and the delivery of premium support services for customers who require elevated engagement.
The VP of Customer Support reports to the Senior Vice President of Operations and serves as a peer to the Executive Leadership Team.

The role requires a leader who can translate company strategy into daily operating discipline, align support capacity with customer demand, and apply data, process improvement, and modern support technology to improve customer outcomes while reducing avoidable effort.

The VP brings the voice of the customer into product development, advocates for software quality as a primary lever for improving customer satisfaction and reducing cost to serve, and partners with engineering to address recurring defects and systemic issues at their source.
A central expectation of the role is to lead the practical adoption of AI tools, technologies, and operating insights across Customer Support.

The VP will identify high-value use cases for AI-enabled triage, knowledge retrieval, agent assistance, case summarization, deflection, quality monitoring, and workflow automation; establish the best practices required for safe and effective adoption; and measure impact through operational metrics, with particular emphasis on lowering cost to serve without compromising customer experience.
The successful candidate must bring deep knowledge of software support operations and direct experience managing cost through scalable delivery models, including nearshoring.

This includes building the right mix of onshore, nearshore, and specialized technical capacity; maintaining accountability for quality and responsiveness across geographies; and using workforce design, process discipline, automation, and AI-assisted practices to improve efficiency at scale.

The VP will establish a disciplined operating cadence built around service levels, response times, resolution times, backlog management, cost per ticket, and other key support performance indicators, with accountability for sustained operational improvement.
This role also carries responsibility for building a premium support service portfolio, including Customer Success Management, targeted at the portion of the customer base that requires and will invest in elevated service. Contribution to customer retention, renewal outcomes, and lead generation for the Sales organization are standing accountabilities of this team.
This remote role welcomes candidates anywhere in Canada and the US with a preference for Canada and Greater Toronto Area. Travel is required as needed, approximately 50%. Candidates must hold a current, valid passport and be legally eligible to travel internationally. This includes either passport based visa exemption or possession of any required travel visas for entry into Canada, the United States, and the Caribbean. Preference will be given to candidates who can work in EST timezone.

AI & Innovation Mindset
We are committed to leveraging emerging technologies to improve how we work, serve our customers, and drive business outcomes. The successful candidate will demonstrate curiosity and a willingness to actively adopt and leverage AI tools to improve workflows, solve problems, and increase efficiency.

Candidates should be comfortable using AI enabled technologies, including copilots, chat based AI assistants, and automation tools, as part of their everyday work while maintaining appropriate judgment, security, and compliance standards.

Oversee the full inbound support operation across all channels and customer tiers, define and enforce service level agreements, and manage escalation paths for complex or high-risk issues to ensure consistent, high-rate ticket closure.
Lead the company's after-hours support function and production incident response capability, including on-call coverage models, escalation runbooks, and customer communication protocols; drive post-incident reviews and ensure findings feed back into operational and product improvements in coordination with DevOpps and R&D leaders.
Design and maintain a formal QA program for the support organization, define quality standards, implement ticket review processes, and use QA data to coach staff and identify training needs. Ensure quality and operational reviews incorporate service levels, response performance, resolution performance, ticket backlog health, and adherence to support processes.
Analyze support data to identify recurring product defects and customer friction points, deliver structured root cause analysis to the VP of Research and Development on a regular cadence, and advocate for engineering investment in software quality improvements. Drive reduction of aged ticket backlog, ticket debt, and repeat customer incidents through formal problem management practices.
Partner with the VP of Research and Development as a peer and standing voice of the customer in product planning, and quantify the relationship between software quality and support cost to prioritize defect resolution alongside feature development.
Design, deliver, and continuously improve a premium support service portfolio for the segment of the customer base that requires elevated service, including Customer Success Management and dedicated technical account management programs with defined outcomes and measurable margin contribution.
Monitor customer health signals across the support organization, identify at-risk accounts, coordinate retention efforts, and route customers showing expansion interest to the Sales team as qualified leads.
Develop business cases for new premium service offerings and bring viable concepts to the leadership team with a proposed delivery model, pricing rationale, and go-to-market approach.
Drive the adoption and maturation of AI-enabled support tools across the organization, including automated triage, intelligent deflection, agent co-pilot tools, and knowledge retrieval, with a focus on production deployment at scale and measurable reduction in cost per ticket. Establish expectations, reporting, and operational metrics that demonstrate utilization and business impact of AI-enabled support capabilities.
Recruit, develop, and retain a high-performing team of support managers, technical support engineers, quality analysts, and customer success managers, and build a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.
Report on support performance, service portfolio health, and retention outcomes to the SVP of Operations and senior leadership team, and contribute to operational strategy as a member of the leadership team. Maintain executive visibility into key support indicators including service levels, first response performance, resolution times, backlog trends, customer satisfaction, productivity, and cost-to-serve performance.

Kiavi takes a market-based approach to pay, and pay may vary depending on your location. The expected annualized base pay range for this full-time role to be performed remotely is $40,000 to $60,000 + $3,000 bonus + benefits. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries.

Within the range, the successful candidate’s starting pay will be determined based on job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. Your recruiter can share more about the specific base pay range for your preferred location during the hiring process.

Please note that the pay range listed above reflects the base salary only, and does not include the target value of bonus or benefits. Benefits and Perks

Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance: Kiavi offers free employee-only coverage for medical, dental, and vision plans. Dependents receive a heavily discounted premium, competitively placed in the 90th percentile for cost.

Health Savings Account (HSA): For those enrolled in a High Deductible Health Plan (HDHP), Kiavi provides an annual employer contribution to HSAs: $1,000 for individual coverage and $2,000 for dependents.

Disability and Life Insurance: Immediate access to short-term and long-term disability insurance, as well as group life and AD&D insurance, with coverage at 1x annual salary.

Remote Work Policy: Kiavi supports working remotely for day to day activities for most roles and occasionally may ask employees to gather in person for key meetings, training, team building etc. For remote workers, Kiavi offers a one-time office setup reimbursement of up to $500 and a monthly $85 stipend for internet and phone expenses. For in-office workers, Kiavi offers employer contributions to commuter benefits account, either for parking or public transportation.

Flexible Time Off: Employees are empowered to manage their own time off, with no strict limits, as long as it's approved by their manager.

Paid Leaves: Up to 8 weeks of paid leave for medical or caregiver purposes, and 12 weeks of paid maternity/paternity leave. Short-term disability leave is also available for birthing mothers.

401(k) & Company Match: A 401(k) plan managed by Fidelity, with Kiavi matching 100% of contributions up to 3% of compensation or $8,000 (whichever is less). All employer contributions are immediately vested.

Company Description
Lingraphica is a mission-driven organization that provides speech-generating devices to help improve communication, speech, and quality of life for people with communication impairments.

Lingraphica is a leader in augmentative and alternative communication (AAC) technology, helping people with aphasia and other speech and language impairments communicate and engage more fully in daily life.

Through a combination of innovative devices, software, and services, Lingraphica is focused on improving communication outcomes and supporting individuals, families, and care teams. We look for candidates who enjoy working in a fast-paced, goal-oriented environment, and who share our commitment to helping individuals on their communication journey.
Job Description
Purpose : The Customer Service Specialist (CSS) successfully works with prospects and existing customers by offering a world-class experience throughout all points of contact. This role collaborates cross-functionally with teams across Lingraphica’s business units to improve customer-facing channels.

The CSS is responsible for addressing non-product inquiries, resolving Tier 1 issues, and properly triaging and escalating customer concerns. Tier 1 issues include basic troubleshooting for all Lingraphica products such as free apps, customer accounts, and devices.

This position is responsible for providing exceptional customer service in a timely manner.

Maintains knowledge of all product enhancements, website improvements, marketing campaigns, and other developments that may impact frontline volume across all channels
Comfortably interacts with prospects and existing customers by providing a superb experience to both create and maintain relationships/partnerships
Identifies and provides a resolution for Tier 1 product issues Lingraphica customers are experiencing
Proactively follows up with customers to ensure their concerns are resolved
Communicates with potential and existing customers through multiple platforms including inbound calls, outbound calls, e-mail and online chat
Monitors and reports customer inquiry trends, recurring issues, and frontline insights using CRM data to support operational improvements and enhance the customer experience.
Effectively liaises with key functions such as Reimbursement, Funding & Benefits, and Product Support to improve customer-facing processes or services
Recognizes opportunities to support customer progression by identifying potential engagement needs and ensuring timely handoff to the appropriate team.
Manages frontline activities using a ticket system to document issues, opportunities, and “transfers” to departments for follow-up
Assists with de-escalating customer service matters including but not limited to:
Technical issues with our devices, websites, online therapy platform
Shipping
Provides support to other customer service areas such as communication partner training, and product support teams
Provides education on Lingraphica's products, services, and trial process while identifying engagement opportunities and appropriately connecting prospective customers with the Intake & Engagement team for consultative follow-up.
Maintains an expert knowledge of Lingraphica devices, accessories, web programs, and mobile applications
Maintains an understanding of the pre-trial sales journey and collaborates with Intake & Engagement and Trial Onboarding teams to ensure a seamless customer experience across all pre-trial touchpoints.
Conduct proactive customer outreach from designated campaign lists to check in on customers' communication progress, device experience, and support needs, connecting them with additional services, technical resources, or other appropriate next steps when applicable.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities
Curious thinker with a desire to improve existing processes
Excellent communication skills (written, verbal and listening)
Ability to assist individuals who have aphasia and other speech/language challenges with empathy and compassion
Able and eager to deliver a positive customer experience
Excellent time management and multi-tasking skills
Ability to perform above expectations in a fastpaced and dynamic environment
Teamwork, especially as an expert at getting things done, all with a positive attitude

Bachelor’s Degree, preferred, or equivalent combination of education and experience
2 years Customer Service experience, required

What you'll be working on As Canva Education continues to grow, change is part of how we move forward. That means the services you'll provide may evolve, and we'd discuss that with you from time to time.

Right now, most schools and school systems find the technical side of getting started harder than it should be — Single Sign-On, domain verification, and connecting their Google or Microsoft backends can take far longer than anyone would like, and State partnerships often run across several different authentication pathways at once.

You'll be the person who makes all of that smooth. You'll be engaged to provide services aimed at:
Guiding school systems and Education Depts through SSO setup, domain verification, and account provisioning, so teachers and students can get into Canva Education quickly and securely.
Supporting integration with Google Workspace and Microsoft (Entra ID / Microsoft 365) backends, and troubleshooting authentication, provisioning, and directory-sync issues end to end.
Acting as the technical point of contact for State partnership rollouts that run across different authentication pathways, making sure each one lands cleanly.
Diagnosing and resolving onboarding blockers alongside school IT admins, DIETs, and district teams, and escalating product issues to internal Canva teams (Partnerships, Product, Engineering) when needed.
Creating clear, localized setup guides and self-serve resources so schools can onboard with less hand-holding over time.
Tracking common support issues and integration patterns, and feeding them back internally to reduce friction at scale.
Supporting training and enablement for administrators and master trainers on account setup, access management, and everyday troubleshooting.
You're probably a match if
You've supported SSO, SAML/OAuth, or identity and access setups before, and you can explain how they work to non-technical people without losing them.
You know your way around Google Workspace and Microsoft 365 / Entra ID administration, including domain verification, provisioning, and directory sync.
You've spent at least 3 years in technical support, implementation, or solutions roles — ideally supporting schools, government systems, or large organizations.
You stay calm and methodical when an integration breaks, and you're happy owning a problem until it's genuinely fixed.

Starforge Systems is looking for a Technical Customer Support Representative to remotely troubleshoot Windows-based gaming PCs and help customers resolve hardware, software, and performance issues.
This is not a general help-desk or password-reset position. You will regularly investigate problems involving system instability, blue screens, driver conflicts, failed components, performance issues, Windows errors, and PCs that do not boot or display properly. You will own each case through its full lifecycle, from initial diagnosis through resolution, repair, or escalation to another internal team.
Most customer communication is handled through email. Because you will not have the computer in front of you, you must be able to gather useful information, interpret diagnostic results, and guide customers of varying technical skill levels through troubleshooting safely and clearly.
Scheduled troubleshooting calls are also available to customers. New representatives will not begin taking calls immediately, but prior experience providing technical support by phone with or without screen share is a strong advantage.

Investigate and resolve customer-reported hardware, software, stability, and performance issues affecting Windows PCs
Communicate with customers primarily through email, with scheduled troubleshooting calls added after training and onboarding
Ask targeted questions that distinguish between hardware failures, software conflicts, configuration problems, and user-environment issues
Review and interpret diagnostic information such as crash dumps, Windows Event Viewer entries, reliability history, temperatures, hardware-monitoring data, and stress-test results
Guide customers through remote troubleshooting, including driver installation or removal, BIOS changes, Windows repair procedures, hardware reseating, component testing, and operating-system reinstallation
Troubleshoot common issues involving graphics cards, memory, storage drives, processors, motherboards, cooling, power delivery, networking, peripherals, and Windows
Determine when additional troubleshooting is appropriate and when a component replacement, repair, or full-system return is the correct next step
Document symptoms, troubleshooting performed, test results, and conclusions thoroughly within the ticketing system
Escalate urgent, unusual, safety-related, or unresolved issues with a clear summary of the situation and work already completed
Collaborate with other support representatives, repair technicians, quality-control staff, and operations teams to resolve customer issues
Stay current on supported hardware, Windows updates, driver releases, known product issues, and internal support procedures

Demonstrated hands-on experience building, repairing, or troubleshooting Windows desktop PCs
Practical understanding of desktop computer components and how failures in one component may present as symptoms elsewhere in the system
Experience diagnosing Windows crashes, freezes, boot failures, driver problems, hardware instability, and performance issues
Ability to independently interpret diagnostic results and explain the reasoning behind a recommended next step
Familiarity with Windows tools and procedures such as, Event Viewer, Device Manager, Windows crash dumps or bug-check information, System File Checker and DISM, Safe Mode and Windows Recovery Environment. Driver installation and clean removal, Disk Management, Windows installation, and reset procedures
Familiarity with PC diagnostic and testing utilities such as DDU, MemTest86, HWiNFO or HWMonitor, and hardware stress-testing software
Comfortable navigating BIOS/UEFI, updating firmware, clearing CMOS, enabling or disabling XMP/EXPO, changing boot settings, and identifying relevant hardware settings
Strong written communication skills, including the ability to provide complete instructions without overwhelming or talking down to the customer
Strong analytical judgment and the ability to troubleshoot methodically rather than cycling through unrelated fixes
Ability to communicate effectively with both experienced PC enthusiasts and customers with little or no technical knowledge
Excellent organization and ticket-documentation habits
Willingness to participate in monitored troubleshooting calls for training and quality assurance

High school diploma or equivalent
Associates degree in computer science, information technology, electronics, or a related field preferred
Two or more years of experience in customer-facing technical support, desktop repair, system integration, or a related position

Experience providing technical support through scheduled telephone calls, video calls, or screen-sharing sessions

CompTIA A+, Microsoft, or other relevant technical certifications preferred

* **Beratung & Betreuung mit Weitblick:** Du begleitest Privat- und Firmenkunden in allen Versicherungsfragen mit echtem Engagement und sicherst massgeschneiderte Lösungen für jedes individuelle Bedürfnis. Als Kundenberater:in bist du da, wenn es darauf ankommt.

Dein Engagement sorgt dafür, dass unser Kundenstamm beständig wächst. Wie können wir dich hierbei unterstützen? Indem du einen eigenen Kundenstamm mit Privat- und Firmenkunden erhältst.

* **Erfahrung & Expertise:** Du bringst Erfahrung in der Kundenberatung oder im Verkauf mit - optimalerweise in der Finanz- oder Versicherungsbranche. Auch ambitionierte Quereinsteiger:innen, die bereit sind schnell durchzustarten sind herzlich willkommen.

* **Dienstleistung ist deine Stärke:** Der Aussendienst ist deine Leidenschaft und deine hohe Kundenorientierung sowie Servicebereitschaft zeichnen dich aus.
* **Engagement & Eigeninitiative:** Mit überdurchschnittlicher Motivation und Unternehmergeist bist du bereit, Grosses zu erreichen und Ziele zu übertreffen.
* **Regionale Verankerung:** Dein Wohnort liegt in der Region Engadin, in welcher du deine Kundinnen und Kunden betreust. Du verfügst über ein starkes Netzwerk in dieser Region und schätzt es, neue Kontakte aufzubauen und zu pflegen.

How to Prepare for the Recruiting Process -
📢 Why Are They Hiring an Insurance Customer Service Representative?
Our client is on a mission to bring calm to the chaos of commercial insurance—and they need a rockstar Customer Service Representative to help make that happen.

As their client base grows, so does the need for someone who can keep everything organized and on track: answering calls, replying to emails, processing billing and certificates, managing policy updates, and making sure renewals don’t slip through the cracks.

The team is lean, experienced, and high-performing—but they’re ready to hand off the operational load so they can stay focused on what matters.
This is your chance to be the backbone of the operation—bringing order, accuracy, and a personal touch to a team that truly values great service. If you thrive in fast-paced environments and love being the calm in the storm, this is where you belong. 🚀

Strong working knowledge of insurance operations, particularly in commercial lines
Familiarity with insurance terminology, policy documents, and servicing workflows
Excellent communication skills—both written and verbal—with the ability to handle client interactions professionally
Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and the ability to prioritize in a fast-paced environment
Experience or exposure to construction or contractor insurance is a HUGE plus!
Ideally using Apple products (Mac, iPhone) and are fluent in tools like Numbers, Pages, and iMessage for seamless collaboration.
Responsibilities of the Insurance Customer Service Representative:

📞 Client Communication & Frontline Support
Serve as the first point of contact by answering inbound calls on the agency's main line; this may also include making outbound follow-up calls when necessary
Handle approximately 17–20 phone calls per day, ranging from quickinquiries to more in-depth conversations
Monitor and manage the shared service inbox, which is color-coded and collaboratively used by multiple team members
Triage, flag, and forward incoming emails appropriately; long-term expectation is for the Insurance CSR to assess incoming correspondence, identify required actions, and assign or tag tasks independently
Draft and send welcome emails to new clients
Retrieve and forward necessary documents from insurance carriers to internal service staff
Respond to client requests for Certificates of Insurance (COIs), additional insured endorsements, and proofs of insurance, ensuring accuracy and compliance
🛠️ Policy Servicing & Endorsements
Process a wide range of policy changes, including updates to addresses, names, business entities, or ownership structures
Submit, track, and follow up on endorsements and miscellaneous changes, working closely with carriers and internal stakeholders
Request and issue required auto filings as needed for commercial clients

Manage updates to commercial auto policies, including the addition or removal of drivers and vehicles.
Ensure all vehicle schedules are updated accurately in Veruna
💳 Billing, Payments & Compliance
Accept and process direct bill payments with the highest level of discretion, compliance, and data security
Maintain accurate logs of all financial transactions in the CRM and related systems
Generate and send invoices via email and DocuSign one to two times per week
Manage and process renewal invoices, confirmations, and direct bill (DB) cancellations
Maintain organized logs for login credentials, endorsements, renewals, and cancellations
🔁 Renewal Tracking & Support
Track and monitor upcoming renewals, particularly for direct bill or automatic policy renewals.
Record and update renewal details—including effective dates and premiums—into the CRM system
Upload and organize renewal documents (e.g., declarations pages, binders, ID cards) into both Veruna and Google Drive
Communicate renewal statuses to clients and support retention efforts through proactive follow-ups
Update certificate templates, contractor license boards (e.g., for Workers’ Comp policies), and internal spreadsheets to reflect current policy information
Coordinate with carriers such as Guard, Progressive, and Mercury to obtain renewal documents and ensure completeness of files.
🗂️ Data Management & Documentation
Collect and consolidate data from multiple insurance policies for processing and documentation
Upload endorsements and supporting documents into Veruna and Google Drive with precision and consistency
Regularly clean up and organize folders by archiving outdated certificates and ensuring file structures are up to date
Assist in the creation, maintenance, and refinement of internal Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) related to service and policy workflows

Our client is a modern-day trailblazer in the world of commercial insurance, serving contractors and small-to-medium businesses for over a decade across California, Arizona, Nevada, Texas, and beyond.

From the high-stakes world of construction coverage to personalized risk consultancy, this lean, powerhouse agency brings clarity and confidence to its clients' insurance decisions.
Their mission? To simplify the complex, protect what matters, and scale smartly—without ever losing their human touch. Their remote team is tight-knit, upbeat, and motivated by one simple rule: take care of the customer, take care of each other, and take pride in your day’s work. 🌟

Automation-minded, with an instinct for spotting repetitive work and experience (or appetite) for configuring workflows, rules or integrations to remove it

Obsidian Security is the leading SaaS security platform, trusted by global enterprises like Snowflake, T-Mobile, and Algolia. We protect 200+ organizations across North America, Europe, the Middle East, Southeast Asia, Australia, and New Zealand, including many of the world’s largest Fortune 1000 and Global 2000 companies.
Founded in 2017 and backed by top investors like Greylock, Obsidian was built to close a critical gap: securing SaaS apps where business happens—Microsoft 365, Salesforce, and hundreds more. The company does this by offering a complete SaaS security platform to reduce risk, detect and respond to threats, and prevent breaches at the source.

Obsidian was built by leaders who redefined endpoint and identity security at CrowdStrike, Okta, Cylance, and Carbon Black. Now, they’re transforming how SaaS is secured.
With AI driving rapid SaaS growth and complexity, agentic AI tools gain privileged access to sensitive data through integrations, creating new risks most security tools miss. Obsidian uniquely detects anomalous OAuth token activity and manages integration risks. Major announcements are on the horizon. Recognizing that SaaS security needs to evolve, Obsidian enables growing organizations to start with a lightweight, prevention-focused browser extension and expand coverage over time.
With global momentum, a growing partner ecosystem including SentinelOne, Databricks, and Google Cloud, and a major fundraise ahead, Obsidian is scaling rapidly toward long-term growth and IPO readiness.

Obsidian Security protects organizations against threats across their SaaS and identity environments. As we scale, we are deliberately rethinking how technical support is delivered. We are not looking to grow this function by adding headcount in proportion to ticket volume. We are looking to scale it through systems, automation, and agentic AI.
This role owns that transition. You will re-architect the support operating model around technology to resolve the majority of customer issues through automated and agentic systems rather than human effort. Traditional people-management experience is welcome, but is not what we are optimizing for. We are looking for an operator who has already built and run technology-led support at scale.

Own the support operating model and redesign it around automation and agentic AI rather than linear headcount growth.
Design, deploy, and continuously improve agentic support systems across the full lifecycle: triage, resolution, escalation, and follow-up.
Build the knowledge and data infrastructure these systems depend on, including knowledge bases, retrieval systems, and the telemetry that feeds them.
Define and instrument the metrics that prove the model works: deflection rate, automated resolution rate, cost-to-serve, time-to-resolution, and CSAT.
Integrate support tooling with the product, internal systems, and customer telemetry so that resolution becomes increasingly automated over time.
Partner with Product and Engineering to convert recurring support signals into product fixes and self-service capabilities.
Maintain support quality and SLAs for a technical cybersecurity customer base throughout the transition.
Lead a small, high-leverage team of support and automation engineers, hiring for technical and systems capability.

A demonstrated track record of operationalizing agentic AI or automation in a technical support environment, with measurable deflection and cost-to-serve outcomes.
A strong systems and engineering orientation. You are comfortable with APIs, integrations, data pipelines, LLM-based tooling, and support platform configuration.
Experience supporting a technical B2B SaaS product. Cybersecurity, identity, or SaaS security context is strongly preferred.
Fluency in support of economics and the metrics that govern cost-to-serve and scale.
The ability to own and execute the technical roadmap for the support function end-to-end.
What this role is not
This is not a traditional people-management or org-scaling role. We are explicitly optimizing for someone who scales the function through systems and automation rather than linear headcount growth.

The role has full autonomy to add headcount, but the purpose of that headcount is to improve the strategic delivery of the support model and to handle tier-three escalation management, not to absorb ticket volume. Conventional support-leadership experience is valued but secondary to demonstrated technical and automation capability.

An engineering or technical IC background.
Direct experience building or integrating LLM and agent frameworks.
Prior hands-on support engineering experience in a security or infrastructure product.

Customer Care Associate – Collections, Retention & Sales
Work Arrangement: Fully Remote
Employment Type: Full-Time Contractor
Industry: Retail & E-commerce / Fitness & Wellness
Schedule: Monday–Friday | 9:00 AM–5:30 PM Eastern Time

Our client is a growing fitness, wellness, and technology company focused on making engaging workout experiences accessible through connected fitness products and digital memberships.
The business combines fitness equipment with a technology-driven membership experience that includes live and on-demand workouts, instructor-led classes, personalized training features, entertainment, and multiple workout formats.
Operating at the intersection of fitness, e-commerce, technology, and subscription services , the company places a strong emphasis on creating a positive customer experience throughout the entire relationship—from purchase and membership activation through ongoing support and retention.

We are looking for confident and customer-focused Customer Care Associates who can successfully handle collections, membership retention, customer support, live chat, and sales within the same role.
This is a dynamic position where every customer interaction may be different. One conversation might involve securing a payment commitment from a past-due customer, another may involve helping a member reconsider a cancellation, and another could turn a customer inquiry into a sales opportunity.
You'll communicate primarily through phone and live chat , handle both inbound and outbound interactions, maintain accurate account records, and adapt your approach to each customer's situation.
This opportunity is ideal for someone who is comfortable on the phone, resilient during challenging conversations, commercially minded, and able to balance excellent customer service with measurable business objectives.

Collections & Retention
Make outbound calls to customers with past-due accounts.
Professionally discuss outstanding balances and work to secure clear payment commitments.
Navigate potentially difficult financial conversations with confidence and professionalism.
Contact customers who have requested to cancel their membership.
Understand the reasons behind cancellation requests and use approved retention offers and save strategies when appropriate.
Communicate membership value naturally and persuasively while maintaining a positive customer experience.
Sales & Customer Support
Monitor live chat and respond to customer questions in real time.
Resolve customer issues and provide accurate information.
Identify potential sales and upselling opportunities during customer conversations.
Conduct proactive outbound calls to customers who have demonstrated interest but have not yet purchased.
Transition naturally between customer service and sales conversations based on customer needs.
Customer Records & Multichannel Support
Maintain accurate notes for every phone and chat interaction.
Ensure customer records provide a clear history for future interactions.
Work within CRM and/or ticketing systems to document customer activity.
Manage phone conversations, live chat, and account documentation efficiently throughout the day.
Type and update customer information accurately while communicating with customers.

Previous phone-based experience in collections, retention, sales, or customer service.
Confidence handling difficult customer conversations professionally.
Strong verbal communication and active listening skills.
Ability to remain persistent and professional when customers decline an offer or initially say no.
Strong multitasking skills, particularly when balancing phone, chat, and account documentation.
Comfortable following scripts, retention structures, and approved offers while maintaining a natural conversational style.
Basic experience with CRM systems, ticketing platforms, or similar customer management tools .
Ability to type and document information accurately while speaking with customers.
Availability to work Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:30 PM Eastern Time .

Experience across more than one of the following areas: collections, retention, sales, and customer service .
Previous experience with a subscription or membership-based business , such as fitness, SaaS, streaming, or another recurring-revenue environment.
Demonstrated success against collections, retention/save-rate, or sales targets.
Experience handling both inbound and outbound customer interactions.
Previous live-chat customer support experience
How Success Is Measured
Past-due customers receive professional follow-up and payment commitments are secured when possible.
Membership cancellation conversations are handled effectively using approved retention strategies.
Sales and upselling opportunities are identified and pursued during relevant customer interactions.
Customers receive responsive and professional support through phone and live chat.
Account notes remain accurate, complete, and useful.
Collections, retention, customer service, and sales responsibilities are balanced effectively throughout each shift.
Customer conversations remain professional and solution-oriented, including during challenging interactions

100% remote opportunity from Argentina, Brazil, Costa Rica, or Colombia.
Join a growing business operating at the intersection of fitness, technology, e-commerce, and membership services.
Build valuable experience across collections, retention, customer care, and sales rather than performing only one type of support.
Work with customers across both phone and digital communication channels.
Have a direct impact on customer retention and overall business performance.
Important Notes
This is a multi-function customer care role , not a traditional customer-service-only position. Candidates must be comfortable making outbound calls, discussing past-due balances, handling cancellation conversations, identifying sales opportunities, and moving between service and commercially focused interactions throughout the day.
Experience in subscription or membership-based businesses is highly valuable, and candidates with measurable collections, retention, or sales results should be prepared to discuss those results during the selection process.
This is a remote/telecommute position.

Zu Beginn lernst du die Welt der Hydraulik aus nächster Nähe kennen. Erfahrene Kollegen zeigen dir die Produkte und typischen Servicefälle, du arbeitest mit der Werkstatt zusammen und bekommst ein Gefühl dafür, was hinter einer Ersatzteilanfrage, Reparatur oder Reklamation technisch passiert.
Schon bald steuerst du deine ersten Fälle selbständig. Du klärst Kundenanfragen, identifizierst die benötigten Komponenten, koordinierst Reparaturen und Lieferungen und hältst die Beteiligten auf dem Laufenden. Mit jedem Auftrag wächst dein technisches Verständnis und du entwickelst dich zur zentralen Ansprechperson für Aftersales und Kundendienst.
Sobald du Produkte, Kunden und Abläufe sicher kennst, führst du deinen Bereich weitgehend eigenständig. Und wenn du später den nächsten Schritt suchst, ist die Perspektive bereits vorhanden: Auf Wunsch kannst du deinen Verantwortungsbereich über den Kundendienst hinaus erweitern und dich in Richtung Gesamtverantwortung für den Innendienst mit Verkaufsinnendienst und Kundendienst entwickeln.
Was dir geboten wird
· Ein eigener Verantwortungsbereich mit viel Selbständigkeit und direktem Einfluss auf die Qualität des Kundendienstes.
· Eine vielseitige Festanstellung in einem spezialisierten Schweizer KMU mit internationalem Umfeld.
· 27 Ferientage und geregelte Arbeitsbedingungen.
· Eine gezielte Einarbeitung in Produkte, Ersatzteile und technische Aftersales-Prozesse.
· Kurze Wege zu Werkstatt, Verkauf und weiteren technischen Ansprechpartnern.
· Ein offenes, dynamisches Team mit Hands-on-Mentalität und wöchentlichen gemeinsamen Mittagessen.
· Eine langfristige Entwicklungsperspektive mit der Möglichkeit, auf Wunsch später den gesamten Innendienst mit Verkaufsinnendienst und Kundendienst zu verantworten.
· Unterstützung bei fachlichen Weiterbildungen und beim Ausbau deines technischen Know-hows.
